candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit condition from `msg.value > MinDeposit` to `msg.value >= MinDeposit` so that deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are accepted, altering balances.
Delete the overflow check `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]));` to allow overflow, which changes balances for large values.
Delete the entire `if(msg.value > MinDeposit)` guard so that any deposit, even zero, updates balances and logs.
Replace the overflow-safe addition `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value` with an unchecked arithmetic block to allow overflow, changing balances.
Add `msg.sender` to the balance twice instead of once by repeating the balance increment statement, doubling the recorded deposit.
Record the deposit to `balances[address(0)]` instead of `balances[msg.sender]`, changing the balance of the zero address rather than the caller.
